name: Answer reveal
summary: Question card with a covered answer; the cover slides away to reveal the answer with a tick sparkle.

params.name: question
params.default: How many hearts does an octopus have?

params.name: answer
params.note: answer revealed under the cover; keep it short

params.name: revealAt
params.note: frames after the start when the cover slides away

params.name: color
params.note: cover colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

example.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?

author: krakujs
